properties.displayName: [IGNORE] GO-PRD-SENTINEL-142 Palo Alto Strata Logging Services - External Port Scanning Activity
properties.description:
The objective of this use case is to detect and monitor external port scanning activity against internal/private assets using Palo Alto Strata traffic logs ingested into Microsoft Sentinel.

This detection identifies suspicious external/public source IPs attempting to scan internal assets by either targeting multiple ports on a single internal destination (Vertical port scanning) or scanning multiple internal destinations on the same port (Horizontal port scanning) within a short time window.

The purpose of this use case is to identify potential external reconnaissance activity, early-stage attacker probing, unauthorized scanning attempts, and possible pre-exploitation behavior targeting internal network assets.
properties.query:
let VerticalThreshold = 150; 
let HorizontalThreshold = 10; // updated from 5 to 10
let ScanLookback = 5m;
let BinTimeBucket = 5m;
let AlertSuppressionTimeWindow = 24h;
let AllowedTrafficTimeWindow = 24h;
//
//Alert Suppression Block
let TriggeredIPs = SecurityAlert
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(AlertSuppressionTimeWindow)
    | extend RuleName = tostring(parse_json(ExtendedProperties).["Analytic Rule Name"])
    | where RuleName has "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-142 Palo Alto Strata Logging Services - External Port Scanning Activity" // Currenlty using has since rule name will be having ingore tag, before moving in prod chnge it to ==
    | extend SourceIP =tostring(parse_json(Entities)[0].Address)
    | where isnotempty(SourceIP)
    | distinct SourceIP;
//
//Vertical Port Scan - External source scanning multiple ports on same internal destination
let VerticalScan = GO_PaloAltoStrataLoggingService
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(ScanLookback)
    | where Activity == 'TRAFFIC'
    | where Action != "allow"
    | where isnotempty(DestinationPort) 
        and isnotempty(SourceIP) 
        and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
    | where not(ipv4_is_private(SourceIP)) and ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP)
    | summarize
        DistinctDestinationPortCount   = dcount(DestinationPort),
        PortSet         = make_set(DestinationPort, 50),
        Action          = make_set(Action),
        FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
        LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
        EventCount      = count()
        by SourceIP, DestinationIP, MF, bin(TimeGenerated, BinTimeBucket)
    | where DistinctDestinationPortCount >= VerticalThreshold
    | extend
        ScanType        = "External Vertical Port Scan",
        Description     = strcat("Single target ", DestinationIP, " scanned across ", DistinctDestinationPortCount, " ports"),
        IPCustomEntity  = SourceIP;
//
//Horizontal Port Scan - External source scanning many internal hosts on same port
let HorizontalScan = GO_PaloAltoStrataLoggingService
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(ScanLookback)
    | where Activity == 'TRAFFIC'
    | where Action != "allow"
    | where isnotempty(DestinationPort) 
        and isnotempty(SourceIP) 
        and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
    | where not(ipv4_is_private(SourceIP)) and ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP)
    | summarize
        DistinctDestinationIPCount       = dcount(DestinationIP),
        DestinationIPSet    = make_set(DestinationIP, 50),
        Action              = make_set(Action),
        FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
        LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
        EventCount = count()
        by SourceIP, DestinationPort, MF, bin(TimeGenerated, BinTimeBucket)
    | where DistinctDestinationIPCount >= HorizontalThreshold
    | extend
        ScanType        = "External Horizontal Port Scan",
        Description     = strcat("Single port ", DestinationPort, " scanned across ", DistinctDestinationIPCount, " hosts"),
        IPCustomEntity  = SourceIP;
//
// Union of both Scans
let ScannerResults = union VerticalScan, HorizontalScan
    | where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs);
//
// Combination of SourceIP and MF which will be correlated with allowed traffic
let ScannerPairs = ScannerResults
    | where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(MF)
    //| project SourceIP = tostring(SourceIP), MF = tostring(MF)
    | project SourceIP,MF
    | distinct SourceIP, MF;
//
//Allowed traffic check
let AllowedTrafficFromScanner = GO_PaloAltoStrataLoggingService
    | where TimeGenerated >= ago(AllowedTrafficTimeWindow)
    | where Activity == 'TRAFFIC'
    | where Action == "allow"
    | where isnotempty(DestinationPort) 
        and isnotempty(SourceIP) 
        and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
        and isnotempty(MF)
    | where not(ipv4_is_private(SourceIP)) and ipv4_is_private(DestinationIP)
    //| extend SourceIP = tostring(SourceIP), MF = tostring(MF)
    | join kind=inner ScannerPairs on SourceIP, MF
    | summarize
        AllowedTrafficCount = count(),
        AllowedFirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
        AllowedLastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
        AllowedAction = make_set(Action)
        by SourceIP, MF;
//
// Final result
ScannerResults
| where not(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIP, "64.39.102.0/24")) // Qualys Scanner IP range
| join kind = inner AllowedTrafficFromScanner on SourceIP, MF
| extend Action = set_union(Action, AllowedAction)
| project-away SourceIP1, AllowedAction, MF1
